features.name: Content consumption · all-following feed
steps: The user opens the home page
The system loads Weibo from followed accounts
A mix of text, images, videos, topics, etc.
The user keeps scrolling
Load subsequent content by pagination or incrementally
The reading state is recorded continuously
features.expected: The home page must load Weibo from followed accounts mixing text/images/videos/topics; the scrolling pagination neither duplicates nor loses items; the reading state is recorded continuously.

features.name: Content consumption · latest-Weibo timeline
steps: The user switches to "latest Weibo"
The system reorganizes the followed content by publish time
Newly published content is inserted at the top
It maintains a strict time order after the user refreshes
features.expected: After switching to "latest Weibo" it must be strictly sorted by publish time; newly published content is inserted at the top; the time order is preserved after a refresh.

features.name: Follow system · specially followed feed
steps: The user sets an account as specially followed
Enter the specially-followed page
Load only content from specially followed accounts
After cancelling the special follow it is immediately removed from that content source
features.expected: After setting a special follow, entering the specially-followed page loads only that account's content; after cancelling it is immediately removed from the content source; the state must persist.

features.name: Social relationships · friend-circle content stream
steps: The user enters the friend circle
The system filters content by mutual follow or friend relationships
Show friends' content
After a relationship change the friend-circle content scope changes in sync
features.expected: The friend circle must filter content by mutual follow / friend relationships (relationship data preset); after a relationship change the content scope changes in sync; the displayed results match the relationships.

features.name: Follow management · custom follow groups
steps: The user creates groups such as "colleagues, classmates, and celebrities"
Add or remove followed objects from a group
Enter the corresponding group
Browse only the content of accounts in that group
After changing the group the results sync immediately
features.expected: After creating a group, followed objects can be correctly added/removed; entering the group browses only that group's account content; after modifying the group the results sync immediately; the group must persist.

features.name: Content discovery · popular recommendation browsing
steps: The user enters popular recommendations
Browse content organized by the preset popularity
View the content details
Category entries navigate correctly
features.expected: Popular recommendations must organize content by the preset popularity; after viewing the details and returning the list state is preserved; the category-entry navigation is correct.

features.name: Content discovery · hot-list display
steps: The user enters the popular ranking
Show the preset list rankings (static snapshot)
Tapping an item opens the corresponding content
features.expected: The list must show the ranking according to the preset snapshot; tapping an entry opens the corresponding content; the position is preserved after returning; the data matches the snapshot.

features.name: Content discovery · Weibo hot-search browsing
steps: The user opens the hot search
View the hot ranking (preset snapshot)
Tapping a hot item opens the topic or search results
Returning preserves the position
features.expected: The hot search must show the ranking according to the preset snapshot; tapping a hot item opens the topic or search results; the list position is preserved after returning.

features.name: Content discovery · category hot-topic browsing
steps: The user switches between categories such as entertainment, society, technology, life, and sports
The system loads the corresponding hot content
Keep the category filter state
It supports continuing into the specific hot content
features.expected: After switching categories the corresponding hot content must load; the category filter state is preserved; tapping enters the specific hot content; the results of each category are distinguishable.

features.name: Video consumption · video-stream browsing
steps: The user enters the video channel
Load the video list (preset)
View the cover, duration, author, and play count
Play the video
Watching enters the history
features.expected: The video list must correctly show the cover/duration/author/play count; after playing it enters the history; the list and playback state are consistent.

features.name: Video consumption · following video stream
steps: The user enters the video "following"
Show only videos from followed authors
The content source expands after following a new author
After unfollowing the corresponding content decreases
features.expected: Show only videos from followed authors; after following a new author the content source expands; after unfollowing the corresponding content decreases; the results match the follow relationships.

features.name: Video discovery · video ranking display
steps: The user enters the video ranking
Switch between categories such as food, pets, cars, and anime
Show the corresponding ranking (static snapshot)
Tapping opens playback
features.expected: Each category's list must show the ranking according to the preset snapshot; category switching gives correct results; tapping enters playback.

features.name: Video channels · featured-channel browsing
steps: The user chooses featured channels such as food, games, music, film & TV, travel, and sports
The system shows the channel content
Continue into the sub-topic
Play the target video
features.expected: Featured channels must show the corresponding channel content; sub-topics can be entered further; the target video plays correctly; channel switching results are distinguishable.

features.name: Watch records · video history management
steps: The user plays a video
The system records the watch history
Enter the watch history to view previously watched content
Reopening continues browsing
The user can clear the history
All history records are deleted in sync
features.expected: After playing a video the history must be recorded; the history list shows previously watched content; after clearing, everything is deleted in sync; reopening allows continued browsing.

features.name: Content publishing · text Weibo posting
steps: The user enters the Weibo body
Set the public scope
Tap send
The system validates the content
Published successfully
The content enters the profile and the corresponding follower feed
features.expected: After a successful publish the content enters the profile and the feed; the public-scope setting takes effect correctly; the system validation blocks illegal content; the content must persist.

features.name: Content publishing · image-text Weibo posting
steps: The user enters the body
Upload one or more images
Adjust the content
Add a topic
Set the visibility scope
Publish
The image and body form a complete Weibo that enters the feed
features.expected: The image and body must form a complete Weibo and enter the feed; the topic and visibility settings are correct; a clear state is given when the image upload fails.

features.name: Content publishing · video Weibo posting
steps: The user selects a video
Upload a video
Add the body and topic
Publish
Enter the Weibo feed and the video channel
features.expected: After uploading the video, adding the body and topic and publishing succeeds; the content enters the Weibo feed and the video channel; a clear state is given when the upload fails.

features.name: Content publishing · topic association
steps: The user edits the Weibo
Add a topic
After publishing, the Weibo is bound to the corresponding topic
The user taps a topic to open the aggregation page
That Weibo takes part in the topic's content display and popularity statistics
features.expected: After publishing, the Weibo must be bound to the corresponding topic; tapping the topic opens the aggregation page; that Weibo takes part in the topic's content display; the topic association must persist.

features.name: Content publishing · long-article publishing
steps: The user chooses a long article from the publishing entry
Edit a longer body and media content
Complete the publishing
A long article generates independent details
It is also propagated via Weibo
features.expected: After publishing a long article an independent details page is generated; the content is presented in full; it is also propagated via Weibo; the edited content is saved correctly.

features.name: Interaction system · reposting on Weibo
steps: The user opens a Weibo
Tap repost
You can attach your own text
Publish the repost
The original Weibo's repost count increases
The reposted content enters the user's profile and their followers' feed
features.expected: After reposting, the original Weibo's repost count increases; the repost enters the user's profile and feed; the attached text is displayed correctly; the repost relationship must persist.

features.name: Interaction system · comments and replies
steps: The user comments on a Weibo
The comment enters the comment area
Replies to comments form a hierarchy
The comment count changes in sync
It is preserved after a refresh
features.expected: The comment must enter the comment area and form the correct hierarchy; the comment count changes in sync; the comments and hierarchy are preserved after a refresh; the comment content is not modified.

features.name: Interaction system · like loop
steps: The user likes a Weibo
The Weibo's like count increases
The content enters "my likes"
Unlike
The state and count roll back in sync
features.expected: After liking, the count increases and the content enters "my likes"; after unliking the state and count roll back in sync; the two states must be consistent.

features.name: Interaction system · saved content
steps: The user favorites a Weibo or content
Establishing the favorite relationship
The content enters "my favorites"
The user revisits later
It is removed from the favorites list after unfavoriting
features.expected: After favoriting, the content enters "my favorites"; the favorite state is preserved on revisits; after unfavoriting it is removed from the list; the relationship must persist.

features.name: Interactive content · poll participation
steps: The user browses a Weibo with a poll
View the candidates
Choose an option and submit
The system records the vote
The poll result updates
After the poll ends only the final result can be viewed
features.expected: After choosing an option and submitting the system records the vote; the poll result updates correctly; after the poll ends only the final result can be viewed; repeated voting is not allowed.

features.name: User relationships · following and unfollowing
steps: The user taps follow on a recommended account, Weibo content, or a profile
The other party enters "my following"
The user starts receiving their content
After unfollowing the relationship is dissolved and the following count updates in sync
features.expected: After following, the other party enters "my following"; their content starts being received; after unfollowing the relationship is dissolved and the following count updates in sync; the state must persist.

features.name: User relationships · follower list and follow back
steps: Enter "my followers" (preset follower list)
View followers
Tap follow back
A mutual follow relationship is established
The state is restored after cancelling the follow-back
features.expected: The follower list is displayed correctly according to the preset data; tapping follow back establishes a mutual follow; after cancelling the follow-back the state is restored; the counts change in sync.

features.name: Message center · mentions, comments, and group notifications
steps: Preset messages (mentions, comments, likes, group messages)
The message entry's unread count
Enter the corresponding category to view
The unread state is cleared after reading
features.expected: The preset messages must make the entry show an unread count; each category is correctly classified; the unread state is cleared after reading; the counts match the list.

features.name: Private-message system · session management
steps: The user opens private messages
Select a contact (preset)
View the history messages
Send a new message
The message send state is correct
The session list is preserved
features.expected: After selecting a contact the corresponding history loads; the state is correct after sending a new message; the session list is preserved; the context is isolated when switching contacts.

features.name: Profile · management of following, followers, favorites, likes, and visit records
steps: The user opens the profile
View one's own Weibo, following, followers, frequently visited, favorites, and likes
Perform follow, unfollow, follow back, and unfavorite operations on the objects in it
All lists sync in real time
features.expected: All lists (Weibo / following / followers / frequently visited / favorites / likes) are displayed correctly; after following/unfollowing/following back/unfavoriting the lists sync in real time.

features.name: Creator system · data and content management
steps: The creator enters the creator center
View data such as reads, interactions, followers, posts, and videos (preset metrics)
Enter content management to maintain videos, articles, and scheduled Weibo
The data and content states are consistent
features.expected: Creator data (reads/interactions/followers/posts/videos) is displayed correctly (preset metrics); after content management maintenance the data and content states stay consistent.

exclusions.feature:
Personalized recommendation engine
Behavior-driven recommendation ranking and content distribution
exclusions.reason: Requires a recommendation model and behavior data (cf. Spotify "Recommendation engine"); the content-stream structure can use preset fixtures

exclusions.feature:
Real-time hot-search and ranking data
Real-time popularity computation, dynamic ranking adjustments, and new-hot-item markers
exclusions.reason: The hot search/rankings are presented as static snapshots (cf. Spotify "Dynamic charts"); browsing and navigation interactions are kept

exclusions.feature:
Cross-user interaction feedback
Original author notifications, others' replies, and author-side data changes
exclusions.reason: Single-user interaction state is testable; cross-user delivery and feedback are out of scope; retained surface: f22 interaction system · like loop

exclusions.feature:
Real changes in follower relationships
Real events of others following the current user
exclusions.reason: The follower-list display and follow-back operation are testable (preset list); others' following behavior is not simulated; retained surface: f26 user relationships · follower list and follow back

exclusions.feature:
Real peers in private messages
Real user message send/receive and the other party's read state
exclusions.reason: Sessions and message states are testable (preset sessions); real peers and read receipts are not verified; retained surface: f28 private-message system · session management

exclusions.feature:
The real event source of notifications
Real generation of mentions/comments/likes/group messages
exclusions.reason: The message state machine (unread/category/read) is testable and requires preset message fixtures; retained surface: f27 message center · mentions, comments, and group notifications

exclusions.feature:
Video platform processing and transcoding
Transcoding pipelines and media-processing states
exclusions.reason: The upload and publish flow is testable; a real processing pipeline is not required (cf. YouTube "transcoding/CDN"); retained surface: f17 content publishing · video Weibo posting

exclusions.feature:
Live content
Live management, streaming, and live-room interaction
exclusions.reason: Live-streaming dependencies (cf. YouTube "live" exclusion); content management such as scheduled Weibo is kept; retained surface: f30 creator system · data and content management

exclusions.feature:
Creator revenue system
Ad sharing, creation incentives, tips, and Q&A earnings
exclusions.reason: Monetization and payment systems (cf. Spotify "Premium / Billing"); creator data and content management are kept; retained surface: f30 creator system · data and content management

exclusions.feature:
Influence ranking and creation hot topics
Real-time ranking and popularity trend data
exclusions.reason: The list data uses a static snapshot (cf. the real-time ranking-data exclusion)

exclusions.feature:
Follower-feed verification on the other side
Whether followers genuinely receive the content
exclusions.reason: After publishing it is visible and testable from the author's own feed; others receiving it is not verified; retained surface: f01 content consumption · all-following feed, f03 follow system · specially followed feed

exclusions.feature:
Real content assets
Real Weibo content, hot-search data, and user data
exclusions.reason: Use synthetic fixture content (cf. Spotify "Real catalog")
